name: Exception Expiry Check
description: Tier 3 (userTriggered): On demand, reviews the compliance-log exception register for expired or improperly-approved rule bypasses.

then.prompt:
Check .compliance-state.json → currentPhase. This check runs on demand at any phase.

Review the exception register in the compliance log (exception entries under compliance-log/). For every active exception, verify the following. Each numbered check names the rule ID it enforces; log that ID in the event below:

1. SEGREGATED APPROVAL [GOV-LOG-004]: An exception for a 🔴 Critical rule was approved by a DIFFERENT person than the requester. Flag any self-approved Critical exception.
2. EXPIRY PRESENT [GOV-LOG-005]: Every exception has an expiry date, within the allowed window (max 30 days for Critical, 90 days for High).
3. EXPIRED FLAGGED [GOV-LOG-006]: Any exception past its expiry date is flagged for resolution and no longer treated as neutral.

Report findings as:
- ✅ Passing (silent if every exception is validly approved and unexpired)
- ⚠️ Warnings (exception approaching expiry)
- ❌ Violations (self-approved Critical exception, missing/over-window expiry, or expired-but-still-active bypass)

If every exception is valid and current, confirm silently.

## Compliance Logging
After completing all checks above, append a JSON event to `compliance-log/events/{today-date}.jsonl` (create the file if it doesn't exist) — ONE event per rule checked, and `ruleId` MUST be the actual rule ID from the check above, NEVER a literal placeholder. Format:
{"timestamp": "{ISO-8601-UTC}", "type": "check", "id": "chk-{date}-{time}-{seq}", "hook": "exception-expiry-check", "trigger": "userTriggered", "ruleId": "{the ID from the checked rule, e.g. GOV-LOG-004}", "ruleSeverity": "{severity}", "result": "{pass|fail|warn}", "message": "{one-line-finding}"}
Log ONE event per rule checked.
